thread:
nina: deploy-bot blocked GA publish for rc7 - release notes author mismatch with cosign subject. tagging security and legal.
deploy-bot: automated alert: release-candidate rc7 blocked -> cosign subject (signer: pipeline-service@ci.redwood) does not match release-notes author (nina@redwood). Policy: signed-by must match release metadata. See /releases/rc7.
carlos: why strict-match? we rotate pipeline keys. we've been allowing pipeline-service to sign for CI in the past.
signing-bot: policy history: as of 2025-01-10, compliance tightened to require release author or delegated signers listed in release-approvals. delegation must be recorded in approvals ticket.
tara: legal: we got an audit ask to prove authorship for GA artifacts. This policy prevents later disputes. We can add delegation entry quickly if appropriate.
nina: I published notes from my account but packaging used a transient CI signer due to cert rotation. I can re-run signing from my user KMS key but that will delay GA by ~90m. Any room for a short conditional carveout?
carlos: options: (A) hold GA until user-signed artifacts are available, (B) temporary approval exception with a signed delegation recorded and timeboxed GA for non-enterprise regions, (C) partial publish: push docs and feature flags but keep artifact unpinned.
tara: legal recommends no GA for enterprise customers until user signature is attached. We can allow a limited public beta (non-enterprise) if delegation is logged and evidence links attached. Need approval ticket updated.
nina: proposal: re-run cosign signing with my key; start a soft-launch to non-enterprise only in 2h if I can't finish signing sooner. We'll add a note to release notes: "Soft-launch: enterprise deployments paused pending author signature evidence."
deploy-bot: note: canary publish command (soft-launch) -> ```/publish --image redwood/inference:rc7 --scope non-enterprise --timebox 4h --require rollback_on=error>0.5%``` will enforce timebox and rollback.
carlos: I'll prepare the delegation entry if we need fast carveout: approvals ticket AP-1758884444 created with delegation audit fields.
signing-bot: signing job queued under nina's KMS key. ETA ~35m. Logs will be posted to https://artifacts.redwood/signatures/rc7/nina-cosign-log.txt.
legal-bot: keep this thread updated with signing evidence link and approvals ticket id. Once evidence is attached legal will lift enterprise block.
nina: signed and uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/signatures/rc7/nina-cosign-log.txt. updating approvals AP-1758884444 now.
deploy-bot: verification passed. GA publish allowed for all scopes. Proceed when ready.
carlos: initiating GA publish now. command: ```/publish --image redwood/inference:rc7 --scope all --release-notes-link https://docs.redwood/releases/rc7```
tara: thanks. legal closing hold. nina, please archive the key rotation timeline in the approvals ticket for audit.
nina: done. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
